## Change / 改动

What problem does this solve? / 解决什么问题？

## Evidence and checks / 依据与检查

Relevant sources, checks performed, and untested limits. Method or field-rule changes need their rationale and applicability.

- [ ] Examples use simulated or explicitly public material; no real individual records or credentials.
- [ ] Relevant English and Chinese documentation is aligned.
- [ ] Checks and remaining limits are described.
